hero.title: Relax. It's all still there.
hero.lede: Every browser window becomes a Project the moment you open it. Close it, forget about it, come back in a month — every tab is exactly where you left it.

features.title: Close it, restore it later
features.body: Done with a Project for now? Close the window. Restore brings every tab back exactly as you left it — titles, order, all of it.

features.title: Groups mirror your tab groups
features.body: Group tabs the normal Chrome way and cntxt turns it into a saved Group automatically — name, color, and all. Stash it inside a Project, or let it stand on its own.

features.title: Jump with ⌘K
features.body: A command palette searches every Project, every Group, and every tab in them — switching context never means hunting through windows.

features.title: Every window is a Project
features.body: Open a window, name it, and cntxt remembers it. No separate save step — it's just how a window works now.

features.title: Live sync, always
features.body: Open a tab, close a tab, move one around — the Project updates in the background. Nothing to remember to save.

features.title: Areas keep Projects organized
features.body: Group related Projects under an Area — by client, by quarter, however you think about your work — so your Project list doesn't turn into one long scroll.

features.title: Move tabs between Projects
features.body: Select a batch of tabs in one Project and send them to another — no drag, drop, and hope.

steps.title: Open a window
steps.body: cntxt names it an untitled Project the moment it sees tabs in it.

steps.title: Work like you normally do
steps.body: Every tab you open, close, or move is synced to that Project automatically.

steps.title: Close it. Restore it whenever.
steps.body: The window goes away; the Project doesn't. Pick it up again in one click, in any window.

faq.q: What happens to my tabs when I close a window?
faq.a: Nothing — cntxt already knows every tab in that window. Closing it just closes the window; the Project and its full tab list are still there, ready to restore in one click.

faq.q: Does cntxt slow down my browsing?
faq.a: No. It only listens for tabs being opened, closed, or moved, and updates your Project in the background — it doesn't run anything on the pages you visit.
Yes — free covers up to 3 Projects and Groups combined, 25 tabs each. Basic and Pro raise those limits and add sync across devices. See pricing for details.

faq.q: Does it sync across my devices?
faq.a: On the Pro plan, yes. Free and Basic keep everything local to your browser; Pro adds sync so your Projects and Groups follow you to another computer.
On Free and Basic, your tabs never leave your browser. On Pro, they sync to your cntxt account and are never shared or sold.

faq.q: Is it available for Firefox or Edge?
faq.a: Chrome today. Firefox and Edge support is in progress.
